HERO.TITLE: SURVIVE AT ALL COSTS
HERO.SUBTITLE: Experience new social battle royale game

STORY.TITLE: What is SOS?
STORY.SUBTITLE: social battle royale game
STORY.TEXT: Each round, you and 15 other contestants compete to escape a deadly island filled with monsters. The trick is: three people can survive. Will you run solo or form friendships with others to escape? Making the right decisions could be the difference between life and death.

DETAILS.SUBTITLE: What’s so special?
DETAILS.TITLE: features
DETAILS.BUTTON-TEXT: You have 30 minutes to find a relic, signal for extraction, and grabone of three spots on the rescue chopper.

REQUIREMENTS.SUBTITLE: Can My Computer Run this game?

TEXT.OS: Windows 7 64-bit only No OSX support at this time
TEXT.PROCESSOR: Intel Core 2 Duo @ 2.4 GHZ or AMD Athlon X2 @ 2.8 GHZ
TEXT.GRAPHICS: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 2GB or AMD Radeon HD 7850 2GB DirectX11 Shader Model 5
